notes:
Summary: Ironshore operates control centers for regional water treatment and flood control; mission-critical SCADA integration, strict air-gap policy for operational networks. They need a Private Redwood deployment that can be installed in an isolated compute enclave with no external egress. Key asks: offline KMS/HSM with dual-key escrow, evidence of SBOM + supply-chain attestations for all firmware, ability to run patches under change-window, and a documented fallback for model downgrades if compute is constrained.

From discovery: very cost-sensitive on per-token economics for high-throughput telemetry reranking, but will pay for extensional security add-ons. Strong preference for pinned model versions + deterministic rollbacks.

Quotes: "We cannot have any outbound traffic from the control VLAN — zero exceptions." — Director of OT.

Security notes: will require on-site pre-prod validation by their SecOps and 3rd-party assessor (expected 2-3 week engagement). IL/impact-level classification being mapped to Redwood product controls (need to show encryption key custody and physical access logs).

Attachments referenced: security questionnaire v1, SOW draft, POC plan (lab steps).
use_case_summary: Primary workloads: short-form operator chat for troubleshooting (low-latency), automated reranking of sensor anomaly candidates (high throughput), and summarization of sensor logs for nightly reports. SLOs: p99 latency < 150ms for chat in isolated LAN, sustained throughput of 5000 inference requests/min during peak batch windows. Must support model quantization to reduce GPU footprint and provide deterministic seeding for repeatability.
